query:
SELECT
                (
                    IF(password IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) +
                    IF(github_oauth IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) +
                    IF(google_oauth IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) +
                    IF(traq_oauth IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
                ) AS "authentication_count: i64"
            FROM
                user_authentications
            WHERE
                user_id = ?
